updates.title: Everyone Sells the Same AI enters final interior review
updates.body: The full 6x9 interior is now laid out, with all ten figures in place and the front and back matter matched to the rest of the list. A last round of proof checks is under way before print files are prepared.

updates.title: Title confirmed: Who Authorised This?
updates.body: The title and subtitle are now set: Who Authorised This? When Machines Can Decide, Act, and Spend. The question mark is part of the book’s structure. The preface asks the question, the middle of the book brings it to a head, and the epilogue answers it.
